prompt: IMPORTANT: the ginger cat MUST REMAIN A REAL PHOTOGRAPHED CAT in every frame - individual hairs, natural tabby fur, real whiskers, normal cat eyes. Never smooth, never glossy, never cartoonish, never a plush toy. It never turns into a person and stays the size of a grown adult human. Plain live television look: no sparks, no fire, no glowing effects, no cartoon effects. Bare knuckles with thin hand wraps, no boxing gloves. Anatomy correct: no twisted joints, no rubbery limbs. Continuous single shot, no cuts, camera completely LOCKED on a tripod with only a tiny tremble; it does NOT zoom, push in, orbit or travel. Vertical shot, bare-knuckle boxing ring. Timing: SECONDS 0-2 the female fighter attacks the cat with a fast combination, the cat blocks with one paw without moving. SECONDS 2-5 THE JOKE: in the middle of her attack the cat simply SITS DOWN on the canvas and starts calmly washing its paw, completely ignoring her. Even sitting it stays huge, its head as high as her chest - it never shrinks into a normal house cat. She stops, lowers her hands and stares at it, baffled. She never touches the cat. SECONDS 5-6 without even looking at her, the seated cat reaches out one paw and pushes her once - she falls backwards COMPLETELY OUT OF THE FRAME. SECONDS 6-8 the cat goes back to washing its paw, alone in the frame. Shot on a long telephoto lens with shallow depth of field: the fighters and the ropes sharp, the crowd and the banners out of focus, no letters or logos legible behind the ring. The ring stays exactly as in the first frame. Do not invent or re-spell any text, no gibberish, no logos of any other fight promotion. Real fight speed, natural motion blur. Photorealistic. No blood, no injury, comedic tone. Audio: arena crowd, a burst of punches, then the noise dropping to a confused murmur while the cat washes itself, laughter building, then a thud and the crowd erupts. No music, no commentary, no speech.
